name: [🎃] EKSPEDISI PARVATA
desc:
Welcome to the adventure of Parvata ⛰️
A majestic mountain range piercing through the clouds,
where every step is a test,
and every summit holds a story.

Steep cliffs, hanging bridges, and deep chasms
will challenge your courage and perseverance.
Yet beyond every obstacle lies breathtaking beauty—
shimmering waterfalls 💧, lush green valleys 🌿,
and star-filled night skies ✨.

🌟 Features

🤝 Carry Other Players
🎣 Fishing & Relaxing Moments
🏞️ Beautiful, Calming Scenery
💃 Dance & Express Yourself

🔒 Important Notes

😌 No Jumpscares
⚖️ Fair & Reasonable Obstacles

Will you dare to follow the path to the summit,
or stop halfway through the journey?
